procedure.method: Independent fresh review with no spawned, resumed or forked agents and no peer reviews or unlisted embedded paths opened. Read the exact pinned packet, literal case, rules, rubric, recording addendum, method README and adapter; verified the declared text, manifest and poster byte pins. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening poster images. The packet source_assets and protected_layouts arrays are empty, so there were no source-image opens or protected-layout reads to perform. Through functions.exec, invoked tools.view_image with detail:'original' and displayed each returned image: R12-C1-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. I actually inspected all fifteen displayed exact assets. Completed the M5 thumbnail view before beginning the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. The subsequent first readings used the displayed pixels, not a required-copy fallback. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. Read PNG metadata without editing assets: native 1672×941, usage720 720×405, thumbnail320 320×180, all RGB. Native ratio judgments use the declared 0.5-pixel single-edge height-rounding tolerance, not a claim of mathematical 16:9 equality. session_id is null because the runtime session identifier is not observable in this review.
